remarks: Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this beautifully renovated 3 bed, 2.5 bathroom home in sought after storybook Newfield/ Pepper Ridge neighborhood. Updated with the best finishes keeping todays discerning buyer in mind you'll enjoy the flexible open floor plan, Hardwood floors throughout and beautiful eat-in-kitchen with stainless steel appliances, custom cabinets, and side entry door that leads out to your private deck overlooking the beautifully manicured back yard creating the perfect indoor/outdoor living experience. Absolutely spectacular primary bedroom with walk-in custom closet and spa inspired bathroom with floating vanity sink, stall shower, and frameless glass door. Enjoy the large mudroom with custom built-ins, heated floors, and 2nd laundry location. Additional features included new hot water heater, electrical, new windows, bathrooms, hardwood floors, railings, simply too many items to list. Walking distance to Restaurants, shops, parks, and places of worship.
